campaign_kind: additive pre-result repair successor: repairs EXACTLY the two adjudicated blockers (O9 governance wording; no bound executable production driver/checkpoint). No scientific content changes.

compute_governance.cap_enforcement: the campaign aborts when cumulative measured CPU-hours reach the cap; the cap is NEVER raised mid-campaign

smt_rejection_evidence.w24: dominated by w16 on BOTH axes (+53.1% CPU and +19.9% wall)
smt_rejection_evidence.w32: +80.5% CPU-hours for only 9.2% less wall time

execution.thread_contract_enforcement: every worker records os.environ for all six variables and REFUSES to certify if any is not exactly '1'; violation aborts the shard
execution.worker_placement: one worker per DISTINCT physical core, taskset -c 0..15

incidental_runtime_classification.definition: fields that vary between two runs of identical science on identical inputs and therefore MUST NOT enter the scientific hash
incidental_runtime_classification.evidence: in the representative replay, 320 of ~12,222 leaves differed across four cells and ALL 320 were in this class; 0 scientific leaves moved

backend.o9_acceptance: Taylor coefficients bit-for-bit identical to the accepted baseline; max radius ratio exactly 1.000000

rejected.O6: inflates certified Taylor radii 23.549x at 256/384/512/768 bits

cover.rule: the exact 316-cell executable cover; no cell added, removed or reordered

immutable_historical_states.prior_p5y_cost_blocked_successor: historically unchanged; SR_BACKEND_OPTIMIZATION = EXHAUSTED_UNDER_FROZEN_SCOPE_AND_PRECISION stands as a true statement about the 1126 CPU-h cap
immutable_historical_states.rule: this successor does not overturn any historical verdict; it authorises a NEW campaign with its own budget

k1_meaning.definition: K1 = the SR cover plus the CUSUM cover under the frozen obligation universe

thresholds.note: reproduced for the record only; NOT redefined here

production_state.reason: pre-result repair checkpoint; awaiting independent pre-run adjudication

protected_trees.rule: these git tree object hashes MUST be byte-identical before and after the freeze; the campaign is additive only

retry_and_resume.resume_rule: a cell is re-run from scratch unless a complete cell record exists whose producer identity AND runtime contract hash match the current process; partial cell state is NEVER composed
retry_and_resume.retry_trigger: infrastructure failure only (host loss, I/O error, OOM). A SCIENTIFIC failure is NEVER retried -- it is recorded and the campaign stops.
retry_and_resume.skip_if_current: a cell certified under the current producer identity is skipped

runtime_qualification_required.openblas_config: OpenBLAS 0.3.34.0.0  USE64BITINT DYNAMIC_ARCH NO_AFFINITY SkylakeX MAX_THREADS=64
runtime_qualification_required.rule: production REFUSES to start unless the live runtime contract hash equals the committed value
runtime_qualification_required.why_the_kernel_binds: SkylakeX vs Haswell changes 62 of 240 certified dyadic candidates on one host (evidence/blas_kernel_sensitivity.json)

scientific_hash_rules.algorithm: sha256 over canonical JSON: sorted keys, separators (',',':'), ensure_ascii, trailing newline
scientific_hash_rules.exact_values: rationals travel as exact strings; interval endpoints are compared as exact dyadic (mantissa, exponent) pairs. No float enters any hash.
scientific_hash_rules.method: built by EXCLUSION -- the record is walked in full and every leaf whose path classifies as INCIDENTAL_RUNTIME is dropped; everything else is hashed

shard_and_manifest_rules.atomic_write: write to a temporary file then rename; a partial record is never visible
shard_and_manifest_rules.manifest: every shard is listed with its sha256 and its scientific_content_hash in the campaign ledger; the ledger is rebuilt from the shards, never appended to incrementally
shard_and_manifest_rules.shard: one cell = one shard = one atomic JSON record

stop_and_abort_conditions: cumulative measured CPU-hours reach the compute cap -> STOP, do not raise the cap
live runtime contract hash != required hash -> REFUSE TO START
any of the six thread variables != '1' in a worker -> ABORT that shard
a scientific obligation FAILS -> STOP the campaign and record; never retry, never adjust a threshold
a protected predecessor tree hash changes -> ABORT immediately
a cell record's producer identity or runtime contract hash disagrees with the campaign's -> ABORT
wall-clock exceeds 14 days -> STOP and report (2x the dense-basis projection)
free disk below 5 GiB -> STOP before writing a partial record
